en: A black and white postcard image showing a semi-industrial area with several tall smokestacks, surrounded by a small town nestled in a valley with a forested hillside in the background. The foreground shows houses, small buildings, and what appears to be cultivated garden plots. There is a prominent building with the sign 'Reformschule Meissen'. The caption 'Meißen – Buschbad' is printed at the bottom.
